incident-bot: [PAGER] metering: detected token_aggregator gap -> shadow-metering delta > 15% (us-west-2). Auto-escalate to #incidents, paging oncall.
Jordan (SRE): ack — I'm paging in. pulling heartbeat + emitter logs now.
Jordan (SRE): quick note: anomaly started ~10:10 UTC, emitter queue depth spiked, then a backlog windowing job fell behind.
Lee (Billing): seeing customer-facing overage flags for a handful of accounts in the last 30m. Emails already queued from billing-alerts. Do we have a lookout for false positives?
Anya (Support): tagged two customers in Zendesk — CS has handholding ready but we need to confirm scope.
Jordan (SRE): investigating. initial query on aggregator totals vs shadow stream:
```sql
SELECT minute, sum(tokens_reported) as prod_tokens, sum(tokens_shadow) as shadow_tokens
FROM metering.metrics_minute
WHERE minute >= now() - interval '40 minutes'
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute;
```
Ravi (ML Infra): on it — looks like async-emitter consumer restarted 3x around 10:09-10:12, likely causing a window slip. Checking consumer logs and commit offsets.
Jordan (SRE): log excerpt: `emitter-loop - WARN - commit failed: OffsetOutOfRange` repeating, then `reconnect backoff`.
Maya (Product Ops): flagged priority: customers with committed dedicated capacity must not see spurious overages. We should hold alerts until we confirm.
Lee (Billing): can we temporarily suppress auto-billing emails? We have a throttle but not a full hold. Need to avoid false charges.
Jordan (SRE): recommendation: 1) enable billing-suppress for window [10:05-10:30] while we reconcile 2) flip aggregator to fallback counting (prefix-only mode) to ensure deterministic counts 3) start a backfill job for missing minutes.
Anya (Support): if we suppress emails, CS needs a canned response. Draft: "We've detected a transient metering reporting issue; your usage is being reconciled and any erroneous overage notifications will not result in charges." Approve?
Maya (Product Ops): approve. add note about expected ETA for reconciliation (initial estimate 2 hours).
Ravi (ML Infra): command I'm running to flip fallback: `kubectl -n metering set env deployment/token-aggregator METERING_FALLBACK=prefix-only --record` (will apply a rolling restart).
Jordan (SRE): I'll coordinate the restart; plan: apply fallback, monitor 5m, then pause billing-emails. If counts stabilize, start backfill.
incident-bot: incident channel pinned: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3309876543
Jordan (SRE): applying fallback now. rolling restart started (pods restarting one at a time).
Ravi (ML Infra): confirm pods 1/3 ready -> 2/3 ready -> 3/3 ready. All good.
Jordan (SRE): post-fallback probe: recent 5m delta now <3% between prod and shadow. Looks promising.
Lee (Billing): holding outbound billing emails for the impacted window. Throttle engaged and queued items moved to staging.
Anya (Support): CS message ready and hitting the four customers that saw alerts. Sending now with note about non-billing.
Maya (Product Ops): customer comms approved. Please tag me on any escalations.
Jordan (SRE): kicking off backfill job: `python backfill_reconcile.py --start 2026-03-15T10:05Z --end 2026-03-15T10:30Z --mode=recompute`
Ravi (ML Infra): backing store commit resumed. I see offset gaps filled by replays, consumer lag dropping to 0.
Lee (Billing): sample of reconciled account: acct_42 showed 0 overage after recompute; queued email canceled. We'll audit top-20 affected accounts before releasing billing hold.
Jordan (SRE): running a diff check across summarizer outputs; attaching sample log snippet:
```
[10:07:11] prod_total=12034 shadow_total=14920 delta=19.2% -> queued
[10:16:42] prod_total=12190 shadow_total=12210 delta=0.16% -> reconciled
```
Maya (Product Ops): great. what's remaining? ETA for full reconciliation?
Jordan (SRE): backfill currently estimating 45m for the 25-minute window at current throughput. I'll update if it slips.
Anya (Support): CS will mark the open tickets as "under investigation - no charges applied" and follow up when we finish recon.
Lee (Billing): once backfill done, we should run a final billing-pass diff and then either purge queued emails or release them if valid. Also flag accounts for automatic crediting if required.
Ravi (ML Infra): posting a quick root-cause note: consumer library had a latent bug when encountering an empty commit batch causing exponential backoff that prevented progress until restart. I pushed a patch to the consumer: `fix/offset-empty-batch` -> CI green.
Jordan (SRE): rolling patch deployment scheduled to-staging, and will promote to prod during low-traffic window unless we need earlier.
incident-bot: incident severity updated -> P2 (customer-visible overage flags but mitigated, no confirmed billing).
Maya (Product Ops): good. create an incident page with timeline and affected customers list. Assign postmortem owners: Jordan (SRE) & Ravi (ML Infra), with Lee (Billing) for customer impact.
Jordan (SRE): will hand off to Eve for morning watch. Eve, summary: fallback applied, backfill running, billing emails suppressed, patch ready to deploy. Last update will be when backfill completes or if delta resurges.
Eve (SRE - next shift): thanks Jordan — I'll take it from here. Please add runbook steps you performed to the incident doc.
Jordan (SRE): done. leaving channel. :wave:
incident-bot: Pager cleared by Jordan at 10:38 UTC.
Anya (Support): CS notes: customers notified, tickets updated.
Lee (Billing): queued emails remain suppressed. I'll run final audit after Eve's confirmation.
Ravi (ML Infra): PR merged to main; release note prepared: "fix: consumer backoff on empty commit batches (prevents metering gaps)".
Eve (SRE - next shift): morning check-in planned at 11:30 UTC to confirm backfill completion.
Maya (Product Ops): thanks team. Postmortem owners, please coordinate timeline & credit decision within 24h.
Jordan (SRE): closing thread from triage side. final note: no confirmed customer charges due to suppression; full reconciliation still in progress.
